newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firmer vs dlr, stable vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firmer vs dlr, stable vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint is seen opening firmer against the dollar but stable against the central bank's currency basket, dealers said.
The forint opened at 181.00/05 to the dollar, up from Thursday's close of 181.54/59.
At opening the forint was stuck at the central bank's resistance level and dealers did not expect any substantial shift from the resistance level.
"However, the dollar/mark may strengthen and this might pull the dollar/forint," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
